name: Michael Chen
journey: From a small-town public school to Google HQ. Failed my first internship interview, rebuilt my skills for 6 months, and cracked it on the second try.
quote: Persistence beats talent when talent doesn't persist.

name: Sarah Johnson
journey: Took a gap year after my MCAT, spent it volunteering at rural health clinics. That year taught me more than any textbook. Matched into cardiology residency on my second try.
quote: Every setback is a setup for a comeback.

name: David Martinez
journey: Left a cushy consulting job at 26 to build a fintech startup. First 2 years were brutal — 3 pivots, 1 near-shutdown. Today we serve 500K+ users.
quote: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.

name: Emma Wilson
journey: Parents wanted engineering. I chose design. Interned for free for a year, built a portfolio of 50+ projects, and landed my dream agency role.
quote: Create the work you want to be hired for.

name: James Anderson
role: Foreign Service Officer, U.S. State Department
journey: Passed the Foreign Service Exam on my 4th attempt. Worked night shifts at a warehouse for 3 years while studying. Every failure taught me what not to do next time.
quote: Success is not final, failure is not fatal.

name: Sophia Rodriguez
journey: From a state college to MS Research. Taught myself ML from YouTube and Kaggle. Won 3 hackathons before landing my dream role.
quote: Your degree opens doors. Your skills keep them open.

name: Daniel Kim
journey: Worked with 3 NBA teams. Started with a small clinic in Austin, no client base. Today I run a 12-member rehab center.
quote: Healing is a partnership, not a prescription.

name: Rachel Green
journey: Started a YouTube channel about study tips during college. Took 3 years to hit 1000 subs, then exploded. Now I mentor students full-time.
quote: Consistency is the only magic trick that works.

name: Tyler Brooks
journey: Studied in Michigan, worked on 5 Formula SAE cars. Applied to Tesla 4 times before getting a callback. Never stopped learning CAD.
quote: Build things. Even small things. That's how you grow.

name: Olivia Parker
journey: Passed all 4 CPA sections on first attempt while working full-time. Managed 60-hour weeks and 4-hour study nights for 8 months straight.
quote: Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.

name: Nathan Hughes
journey: Wrote a children's health book alongside my residency. Rejected by 12 publishers before #13 said yes. Now a bestseller in 3 languages.
quote: Your side hustle might become your main story.

name: Maya Thompson
journey: Started as a graphic designer, self-taught UX in 6 months. Cold-emailed 40 companies for feedback. Landed at Airbnb via a Twitter DM.
quote: Your portfolio is your real resume.
